text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as I was walking in front of the station...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Liiike we said, the glass was already broken
by the time we got here~.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, what are you saying?!
A lie like that won't work on me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Geez, why won't you understand~?! Come on, Grandpa~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haa... But really, we weren't the ones who broke the shop's window.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, without a shred of remorse between the two of you.
Frivolous on the outside, and frivolous on the inside!
Good grief, youngsters these days...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute.
Could you not judge me purely on looks?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Gold City's competitive fire has been lit.
Leaving things as they are feels like a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!?
What are you doing here?
choice_data_list: Because you looked like you were in trouble.
Because you looked like you were having trouble.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's not like I needed you to go out of your way to help me or anything...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Lucky! Then I'm counting on ya☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Geez, Jordan...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, but for real though.
Stuff like this is best left to the adults.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Are ye the guardian of these young'uns?
How do ye plan on takin' responsibility for this, eh?
choice_data_list: I sincerely apologize for this matter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer,
why are you apologizing...!
choice_data_list: I will take responsibility, but please let me confirm first.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text: "...Check? Check what?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After waiting for the shopkeeper to calm down,
we decided to inspect the scene and ask around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, fortunately,
someone at a nearby café happened to witness the moment the incident occurred—

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you those brats?!
The ones who smashed the glass at my shop...?!

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for troublin' ya.
Thanks to you, I'm saved.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: I'm glad the real culprit was found.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I'm sorry to you folks too.
I got all heated and wouldn't listenâit was truly childish of me.

text_block_list.name: Old Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
I was wrong to assume you were lying...
I'm truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, thanks a bunch! Going to City's
Trainer really was the right call~☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...No fair.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Butting in on your own with talk about being a guardian and taking responsibility.
It's not fair how you just went and solved it right away.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, that also helped me
in its own way. So...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about earlier.
I'm glad you were there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You know, you really are an adult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like the way Gold City looked at me that day
was just a little bit different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“...... Normally, I'd just snap back with 'Annoying',
but I'll let it slide today.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll bring some snacks by the Trainer's office next time.
I hate feeling like I owe you one."
choice_data_list: Maybe a box of sweets, since I owe you a treat...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? So annoying..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed those parting words were unnecessary...
